name: Massachusetts
short: Mass Save pays up to $8,500 for a whole-home heat pump and $750 for a heat pump water heater, with 75% to 100% off insulation after a free home energy assessment. Income-qualified households can get up to $16,000 or no cost for a heat pump. Homes in towns with a municipal light plant are not covered by Mass Save's electric programs. The federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.

rows.rules: Whole-home system. Mass Save electric customers only, not municipal light plant towns.
